experiences.description:
Leadership oversight for approximately 75 FTEs including four subordinate supervisors.
Responsible for overseeing several areas in the organization including: merchandising, merchandise flow management, inventory analysis, and payroll management.
Oversees the development and education of all employees.
Develops strong communication channels with internal and external clients.
Creates the content of the job descriptions for staff, with emphasis upon identification and definition of core competencies.  
Performs probationary and annual reviews of all staff.
Responsible for developing and managing annual operating budgets.
Manages and assists with the updating of organizations policies and procedures.

Provide great customer service, responding quickly and diplomatically to customer concerns to ensure superior service and satisfaction.
Train new employees on sales operations and daily systems usage.
